limits: The continuous geometric clearance proof covers the actual declared rigid prismatic translation and own visual supports only. It does not model loads, friction, bearings, latches, damping, external walls or body collision.
Native exports are static closed/open derivatives with retained marker/motion nodes; source has the editable action. Derivatives add no design.
Only eight declared care-field rays and two top/edge negative controls are privacy evidence. Opaque hits do not establish confidentiality outside the finite field.
Whole declared voids use 0.2mm surface tolerance; collision compounds are proposals, not moving engine solids.
